verdict.rationale: Jan runs a local llama.cpp-powered OpenAI-compatible API server, so concurrency and throughput under multiple sessions is a fair question for this product. However, the evidence never mentions reserved capacity, parallel slots, request queuing, or steady throughput under concurrent requests. The API server docs cover only endpoints, host binding, and prefix settings.

support.subject: As a power-user, I know the runtime reserves dedicated capacity so throughput holds steady when multiple agents or sessions issue requests concurrently
